Build scope

What Turnkey Design Build includes

Turnkey combines the stages that are usually split across designers, contractors and furniture suppliers.

01Space planningConcepts, layouts and circulation.
023D visualizationPhotorealistic approval before physical work.
03Technical packageMaterials, lighting, electrical and working drawings.
04BOQ and cost planEvery trade, material and item costed.
05Construction and MEPPartitions, ceilings, floors, power, plumbing and HVAC.
06Custom joineryKitchens, wardrobes, workstations, counters and millwork.
07Furniture and fixturesCoordinated pieces made or procured to specification.
08Snagging and handoverInspection, cleaning, documentation and warranties.

A controlled programme

12 steps from brief to handover

Decisions are approved in sequence so the site team can build with fewer changes and clearer accountability.

01

Brief and survey

Confirm goals, site conditions and what is technically possible.

02

Concept design

Set the spatial character, palette and material direction.

03

Space planning

Resolve layouts, furniture positions and circulation.

04

3D visualization

Review and approve the finished space on screen.

05

Material specification

Select every finish, fixture and key fitting.

06

BOQ and cost plan

Approve an itemized budget before contract.

07

Contract and mobilisation

Fix milestones, payment schedule and programme.

08

Strip-out and prep

Remove agreed elements and prepare the site.

09

MEP first-fix

Install power, plumbing, HVAC and data infrastructure.

10

Finishes and furniture

Build walls, ceilings, floors, joinery and furniture.

11

Quality inspection

Correct snags, re-inspect and deep clean.

12

Formal handover

Issue documentation and release the finished space.

Indicative PKR pricing

A practical range before the survey

These planning figures come from the service scope. The proposal is fixed only after site review and specification approval.

Basic TurnkeyPKR 4,500–6,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 9M–12M
Mid-Spec TurnkeyPKR 6,000–8,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 12M–16M
Premium TurnkeyPKR 8,000–14,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 16M–28M

Examples use a 2,000 sq. ft. project. Final cost depends on area, MEP, joinery, furniture and specification.
